data.body: [P2] Bind the user attempt to the initial operation segment. When two completed-step segments are present, this parent expectation accepts either segment. Moving the sole `otel-before-wait attempt 1` beneath the resumed replay segment, with timestamps inside it, still satisfies every assertion. Case 21 therefore passes when the initial invocation lacks its attempt and an attempt appears only during replay. Require `$occurrence: 1` on this parent and add a regression that moves the sole attempt to the replay segment, as case 25 already tests.
